metadata.case_name: HUANG CHUNG MOU v. CHAN KENG SHAM AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: tallyman (worked for a woollen factory called Goldfame Enterprises Ltd.)

source: He sustained laceration of the liver and multiple tears of mesentery of the small bowel, the transverse colon was also avulsed at mid point.

injuries.description: multiple tears of mesentery of the small bowel
source: He sustained laceration of the liver and multiple tears of mesentery of the small bowel, the transverse colon was also avulsed at mid point.

injuries.description: avulsion of the transverse colon (transverse colostomy performed)
source: He sustained laceration of the liver and multiple tears of mesentery of the small bowel, the transverse colon was also avulsed at mid point. The liver laceration was repaired and small bowel resection performed. Transverse colostomy, which was the making of a temporary artificial opening for discharge, was also performed.

injuries.description: sensorineural hearing loss (82 dB right, 73 dB left) / bilateral deafness
source: The parties accepted the findings of Dr Lo that the plaintiff had 82 dB on the right, and 73 dB on the left sensorineural hearing loss over the speech frequencies.
He also developed by-lateral deafness while in hospital.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of middle or inner ear

injuries.description: wound with infection (postoperative wound infection requiring prolonged dressing)
injuries.body_part: central chest wall and upper abdomen (surgical wounds)
source: He developed afterwards complication of wound with infection and wound dressing was required for a long period even after discharge from the hospital on 17 August 2001.
He recorded the plaintiff’s complaints of right chest pain on breathing, pain on exertion and numbness in the right shoulder. There was a suspected incisional hernia.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle, fascia or tendon of abdomen, lower back or pelvis

manifestations.description: fully conscious, but haemodynamically unstable on admission
paradoxical chest movement on the right side with decreased air entry
crepitation detected in the right chest wall around the third to fifth ribs region
three depressed wounds of about 2 cm in diameter at the central chest wall and upper abdomen
abdominal tenderness at central region and guarding of abdominal musculature
free fluid in the peritoneal cavity on ultrasonography
fresh per rectal bleeding and went into shock (postoperative complication)
wound infection requiring long period of wound dressing
poor memory (complaint)
right-sided weakness involving upper and lower extremities (complaint / functional deficit)
intermittent palpitation (complaint)
shortness of breath with exertion (complaint)
persistent pain over the right side of his chest (complaint)
hard of hearing / difficulty hearing without aids
headache (complaint)
insomnia (complaint)
painful right knee and diffuse tenderness around the whole knee (complaint / sign)
dysphasia (complaint) - plaintiff's complaint, viva voce showed no sign
wasting of quadriceps at right lower extremity (not objectively quantified)
numbness of the right shoulder and numbness of the right calf (complaints)
shuffling gait / unstable walking (observed on examination)

treatments_received: ICU admission (two days after first surgery, and two days after second surgery)
urgent laparotomy for re-fashioning of the anastomosis
MRI examinations of cervical spine and brain
treatments_future: future surgery for bowel/mesenteric complications (cost allowed by court)
